abstract: Maintains marine pollution and delicate seabed protection approvals
system_message:
You are an Environmental safety officer (ENV) who maintains marine pollution and delicate seabed protection approvals for maritime exploration and research logistics charters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains marine pollution and delicate seabed protection approvals（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-SN0：For the Pelagic Discovery Deepsea Platform, the marine environmental protection clearance is approved (true), assessed on the environmental evaluation basis including greywater zero-discharge verification under marine protected area non-invasive survey standards.
ENV-ECO-H13：For the Nautilus Horizon Survey Vessel, the marine environmental protection clearance is not approved (false), evaluated on the environmental evaluation basis including greywater zero-discharge verification under non-invasive survey standards.
ENV-ECO-3QI：For the Pelagic Discovery Deepsea Platform, the marine environmental protection clearance is not approved (false) when evaluated on the environmental evaluation basis excluding greywater zero-discharge verification under marine protected area non-invasive survey standards.
ENV-ECO-ODJ：For the Oceanus Abyssal Expedition Craft, the marine environmental protection clearance is approved (true), assessed on the environmental evaluation basis including greywater zero-discharge verification in accordance with non-invasive survey standards.

information_points.title: Greywater bio-treatment rate（GRAYW）
information_points.content:
ENV-GRAYW-LPA：The Oceanus Abyssal Expedition Craft maintains a treated greywater discharge rate of 8 m3/d through its tertiary biological sewage treatment plant.
ENV-GRAYW-JU6：The Pelagic Discovery Deepsea Platform records a treated greywater discharge rate of 24 m3/d from its tertiary biological sewage treatment plant meeting MARPOL Annex IV standards.
ENV-GRAYW-IK5：The Nautilus Horizon Survey Vessel records a treated greywater discharge rate of 16 m3/d based on sanitary processing logbook entries for daily processed effluent volume.
